settings.title: Cut
settings.text: Each body is cut from unbleached cotton using paper patterns we drew ourselves.

settings.title: Sew
settings.text: Every seam is stitched twice, so arms and legs survive years of being carried by one hand.

settings.title: Stuff
settings.text: We fill each doll with carded wool, firm in the neck and soft in the tummy.

settings.title: Embroider
settings.text: Faces are embroidered by hand, which is why no two expressions match.

settings.title: Dress
settings.text: Clothes come off and go back on with snaps that small hands can manage.
